commit_message:
updating: one key listing per store (#45): write path reuses membership, verify lists once (#54)

* updating: contains_for= seam, one key listing per store (#45)

contains_by_lookup (default, unchanged) or contains_by_listing (one listing per
store instead of one membership test per key, e.g. HeadObject on S3), on
update_with_policy, backfill, reconcile and verify. The write path reuses the
membership the decision was made on instead of testing it again.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* updating: drop contains_for; cached_keys for one listing per store (#45)

Review of #54: dol.trans.cached_keys(store, keys_cache=set) already lists a
store once and answers `in` from that listing, kept current on writes, so the
contains_for seam (a stale snapshot that listed twice) is removed.

- update_with_policy still reuses the decision-time membership on COPY/DELETE;
  a DELETE whose key vanished since the decision is skipped, as before.
- verify's default keys (None) list each store once and answer membership
  from those listings: no per-key lookup.
- reconcile/backfill/update_with_policy docs point to cached_keys for S3.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* updating: review fixes for #45 (real KeyError on delete raises, verify reports unreadable listed keys, set-only cache note, tighter tests)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
